## Goal
- Execute the owner's FINAL IVX PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT order: close all 10 remaining items (password reset, physical-device QA, direct APK delivery, production data validation, full module smoke test, chat/reels QA, deployment traceability, exposed-token rotation, autonomous incident-loop proof, final acceptance gate) with direct evidence — Phases 1–5 of the prior mandate are already complete.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Never mark VERIFIED without evidence; no narrative in place of screenshots/logs/IDs/URLs; do not close while any P0/P1 remains; do not ask for credentials unless a runtime test returns missing/expired/401/403
- Password reset: no identity-verification bypass, no disabled security; must test with real owner account, confirm delivery, set new password, verify old password rejected, record timestamps/trace IDs
- APK: direct downloadable artifact (not EAS dashboard page) with filename, SHA-256, EAS build ID, profile, source SHA, package ID, signing status
- Final response must use owner's exact 29-field "FINAL IVX PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT" structured format
- QA cadence: health 5m, auth 15m, full matrix + owner-chat report 2h
- Owner token (~15 min TTL): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; longer-lived Supabase session via admin generate_link + `/auth/v1/verify` (saved `/tmp/owner_at`, `/tmp/owner_rt`)
- Guarded pipeline: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` `{action:"github_commit_file", confirm:true, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE", reason, input:{path,content,message,branch}}`; also `supabase_execute_sql` (CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, 50k max), render actions (CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE for env upsert); Cloudflare WAF blocks ≥~100–200KB payloads (never re-commit backend/hono.ts 306KB — use backend/hono-extended.ts)
- Management API SQL: `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query` `{"query":"..."}` → 201/400; multi-statement + DO $$ ok; ~55s timeout; token in `/tmp/sbp_token`

## Progress
### Done
- **Phase 1 VERIFIED**: 11/11 migrations applied in `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` (22:45–22:58 UTC, checksums+timestamps); runner live at `GET/POST /api/ivx/autonomous/migrations` (owner-only; 401 no-auth); final totals `{total:11, applied:11, pending:0, drifted:0, missing:0}`
- Docker fix: image lacked `expo/supabase`/`expo/scripts` → runner reported 11 file_missing; added `COPY expo/supabase ./expo/supabase` + `COPY expo/scripts ./expo/scripts` to Dockerfile (commit `1b08cf809409` = new HEAD); Docker rebuild live ~23:17 UTC
- 4 checksum_drift entries confirmed as trim artifacts (trimmed md5 matched runtime); reconciled via Management API `update ... set checksum=...` (HTTP 201) → 0 drifted
- **Phase 2 VERIFIED**: GitHub HEAD = Render deploy `dep-d9dbg9668t0s73dga6d0` (live, 23:20:04Z) = /health sha `1b08cf809409452c505bfaf3105bdf980164dd44`; /health 200 healthy, AI gateway key loaded
- **Phase 3 VERIFIED**: 182 public tables, 0 RLS-disabled, 0 zero-policy; 58/58 module tables across 8 groups (owner AI chat 15,333 rows; intent capture 501; core investing 25)
- **Phase 4 — 9/10 PASS**: owner login/logout+revocation/invalid-password/refresh/test-user lifecycle all PASS; password reset = 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` (JOB-0005)
- **Phase 5 VERIFIED**: 2h matrix tick in `ivx-auth-qa-scheduler.ts` now calls `getMigrationSummary()` + `postQAReportToOwnerChat()`; commits: reporter `1e4752752933`, runner `fbdcf9f0e6aa`, scheduler `60bf3258ccc4`; reports confirmed in ivx_messages at 23:12 (QA-00060), 23:17 (QA-00066 FAIL → INC-0001 during deploy restart, auto-resolved), 23:20 (QA-00068 all green 11/11)
- Ledger updated via `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger/update`: JOB-0022 VERIFIED; JOB-0011/0020/0016 RUNNING with evidence notes
- Final evidence package for Phases 1–5 delivered to owner
- Render diagnostics verified live via `GET /api/ivx/render-diagnostic?limit=3` (owner bearer) — service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` not suspended

### In Progress
- Owner's 10-item FINAL CLOSEOUT just issued; fresh verification pass done (health/HEAD/deploy/migrations/QA-state all green); remaining closeout items not yet started

### Blocked
- Password reset email: Supabase built-in SMTP 429 rate limit — needs custom SMTP config, quota fix, or SMS-OTP fallback (closeout item 1)
- Physical Android/iPhone device QA + auth screenshots (items 2–3): requires on-device install; APK v1.4.6 build 38 arm64 exists (SHA `0b7ced1b…894c7`, 45.3MB, 7-day URL from JOB-0006)
- `sbp_f5ad980bd19f4edd6014a787433e00bdb8267454` token was pasted in chat — rotation required (item 8); rotation itself is Supabase dashboard action (account tokens page)
- GitHub token lacks `workflow` scope (APR-004); service-role rotation (APR-001); release keystore (APR-003) — owner actions

## Key Decisions
- Management API `database/query` is permanent migration path (no DB password); history table custom `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` with trimmed-content md5 checksums
- SQL files repaired in-repo and re-committed (guarded DO blocks) rather than skipped; drift checksums reconciled to trimmed md5 only after proving content-identity
- Migration SQL manifest files shipped in Docker image so runner checksums at runtime
- QA chat reporter posts via ivx_messages REST insert (service-role, sender_label 'IVX Autonomous QA (W6/W9)', room `ivx-owner-room`); never throws
- Local shell lacks `RENDER_API_KEY`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` env — use production endpoints (`/api/ivx/render-diagnostic`, `/api/ivx/developer-deploy/status`) for deploy/repo facts instead
- `bunx tsc --noEmit` full-repo has pre-existing errors — grep-filter for touched files only

## Next Steps
1. Item 8 (token rotation): check if Management API can rotate its own token; otherwise prepare owner instruction + swap `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` on Render via render_upsert_env_var, verify old revoked / new works / migrations endpoint still green; run secret scan of repo/logs
2. Item 1 (password reset): retry `/auth/v1/recover` after cooldown; if still 429, configure custom SMTP in Supabase (Management API config endpoint) or implement SMS-OTP owner fallback; complete full reset→new-password→old-rejected proof
3. Item 4 (data validation): per-module row counts (total/active/archived), latest timestamps, API endpoint HTTP codes for members/investors/buyers/properties/deals/reels/messages/media/documents/transactions/owner settings/variables via Management API + REST
4. Item 5 (smoke test): HTTP status + latency for all public and owner routes; fix failures
5. Item 9 (incident loop): run one controlled non-destructive test incident → detect/open/remediate/retest/close/report proof
6. Item 7: assemble immutable traceability set (HEAD=deploy=health=APK source, migration version match)
7. Deliver final 29-field structured closeout; honestly mark device-QA/screenshot items if hardware unavailable — do not fake VERIFIED
